source.title: Band of the Swarmcaller — LIVE WoWDB Quick Info, patch 12.1.5

notes: LIVE WoWDB catalog Quick Info explicitly labels item 281029 Cannot be disenchanted and says added in patch 12.1.5 (build 69594). Kith'ix raid Finger-slot named item. This is a SOURCE-ONLY base catalog eligibility flag, not an original live-client disenchant attempt. Source shows base ilvl 219; cannot generalize to bonus-linked and raid-scaled item variants or to what player could disenchant at cast time. No numeric processing cohort, materials or probability. The corresponding LIVE Wowhead item page displays item identity but no player at-cast attempt.
